question: Does the page272 EAEL masonry require a lightbox to match the Hedge reference?

evidence.shared_source_runtime: build/source-interactions-v001.js contains generic .js-zoom lightbox support, but that proves capability only; it does not prove every masonry on every source page carries .js-zoom.
evidence.gallery_page258: reports/subpages/gallery-eael-masonry-v001.json explicitly records source zoom_count=44 and therefore implements popup=media, full-image clickability and photo-gallery chain.
evidence.hedge_page272: reports/subpages/hedge-eael-masonry-v001.json records source_gallery_count=28 but no source zoom_count, and intentionally implements popup=none.
evidence.later_page272_finalization: Later Hedge gallery closeout focuses on exact 28 names/order/full URLs/id=0 decoupling and does not identify a missing popup/lightbox as a reproduced defect.

decision: NO_WRITE. Do not turn on EAEL popup for page272 solely from the generic D17 wording or from the existence of generic initZoom code. A current trustworthy Hedge source DOM must first prove the 28 source gallery items are zoom/lightbox controls or otherwise clickable into a grouped lightbox.
future_live_gate: On a trustworthy source Hedge DOM, inspect the 28 Sövénymunkák items for .js-zoom/buttons/anchors and accessible click controls.
If source items are noninteractive, preserve popup=none.

If source items are proven grouped lightbox controls, then read current EAEL widget settings and prepare the smallest page272-only setting change to popup=media without altering items/order/names/URLs/id=0/full resolution.
Do not infer from Gallery page258 because that source explicitly had 44 zoom items and is a different page contract.
opera_current: Stale/untrusted for Hedge in this continuation; no live zoom claim made.
